purpose: Source metadata comparison ONLY, never proof of a genuine new normal-bearing evaluation

baseline.model_aggregation: median of 12 dimensionless source-signal features across four conditions

candidates.remarks: All six Paderborn healthy physical bearings were used earlier for training/development or K006 heldout; not fresh.

candidates.dataset_name: KAIST rotating-machine vibration, acoustic, temperature, and motor-current under three loads
candidates.remarks: Different rig, rates and 3 load regimes; no verified 80-recording four-condition per-bearing input. Not directly scoreable by frozen Paderborn model.

candidates.dataset_name: KAIST vibration and motor current bearing dataset under changing rotational speeds
candidates.remarks: Variable-speed different-source rig. Rate/time alignment and comparable asset-level conditions not proven.

candidates.dataset_name: BJTU-RAO bogie / PHM 2024 bearing and drivetrain competition
candidates.primary_evidence: 2026 Oxford Academic PHM24 paper and 2025 BJTU-RAO experiment paper
candidates.remarks: Original authors provide a Google Drive folder and Baidu Netdisk distribution links (IEEE Access 2025 DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3551603), but actual original files/physical healthy bearing IDs/checksums/source dataset license are NOT verified in FaultMate. Both sensors reportedly sampled at 64kHz under 9 rail-bogie conditions, not original Paderborn 4x20 type 6203. PHM24 and BJTU benchmark subsets may overlap. Do not score frozen Paderborn model.

safety_limits: No candidate metadata proves an externally validated healthy false-positive rate.
Source metadata is not a downloaded or checksum-verified per-bearing signal inventory.
Unknown distinct healthy physical asset count must never be replaced by recording count.
Do not relabel a new dataset's 3 loads or variable speed traces as Paderborn's 4 original conditions.
Do not silently resample, add missing current channels or infer physical units.
Any externally adapted model is NEW and requires independent validation; previously opened assets do not become fresh tests.
Frozen Paderborn experiment remains unapproved and inaccessible from runtime.
PHM2024/BJTU-RAO are potentially overlapping distributions, not two independent healthy datasets; verifying physical asset IDs is essential.
A 64kHz sampling match alone does NOT establish same sensor location, axlebox bearing type, four Paderborn operating conditions, original signal identity, or permitted reuse.
